description: Highlight components with repeated rerenders and explain likely causes using heuristics derived from the exported profile.

limit.description: How many components to include. Defaults to 10.

minActualDuration.description: Minimum total actual duration in ms for a component to appear — render time including its children, the same metric this tool ranks cost by. Filters sub-millisecond noise. Defaults to 0.

name: get_rerender_causes
title: Get Rerender Causes
